Required env (every chain):   DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY        \u2014 broadcaster   TREASURY                    \u2014 Safe / multisig that owns proceeds Optional env (chain-overridable):   USDC                        \u2014 overrides the per-chain default below   ENTRYPOINT                  \u2014 overrides the canonical 4337 v0.7   PROTOCOL_FEE_RECIPIENT      \u2014 defaults to TREASURY Run:   forge script script/DeployMainnet.s.sol:DeployMainnetScript \\     --rpc-url $RPC_URL --broadcast --verify Safety:   - The script asserts that `block.chainid` is one of the supported     chains. Catches accidental mainnet vs testnet deploys.   - The script reverts before any state if TREASURY is the zero address.   - 0.5% system fee is hard-coded; do NOT change without a governance     review
